summary: A conversion‑focused niche landing page for busy executives who want a real personal assistant — not another chatbot. The page reuses Super’s proven comparison‑page visual system, positions Super against Siri, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Folk, and Orchids, and grounds the narrative in current reporting on executive AI assistants and computer‑use agents. Emphasis is on Super’s ability to operate real software and reuse a computer‑use cache so repeated executive workflows get faster and cheaper over time.
